titles.title: Consumer Financial Protection Accountability and Reform Act of 2026
Consumer Financial Protection Accountability and Reform Act of 2026
To make reforms to the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, Small Business, and Oversight and Government Reform, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
